content: स्वदित {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} Tasted, eaten. .{@-तम्@} An exclamation meaning ‘may it be well tasted or relished’, uttered at a Śhraddha ceremony after the presentation of rice-balls or oblations of food to the Manes; पृष्ट्वा स्वदितमित्येवं तृप्तानाचामयेत्ततः <ls>Ms. 3. 251</ls>, <ls n="Ms. 3.">254</ls>.
